name: Yangshao culture
capital: No capital (village sites such as Banpo)
summary: A Neolithic farming culture along the middle Yellow River in China, known for painted pottery and villages such as Banpo.

location.value: The middle reaches of the Yellow River in China.

terrain.value: The loess plateau of the middle Yellow River, with fertile, easily worked soil.
terrain.source: Liu & Chen, The Archaeology of China (2012)

climate.value: Warmer and wetter than today, during the Holocene climatic optimum.
climate.source: Liu & Chen, The Archaeology of China (2012)

resources.value: Loess soil for millet farming, pigs, dogs and wild plants.
resources.source: Liu & Chen, The Archaeology of China (2012)
